Configuration files

Where Aurora keeps its settings, which files you can edit, and what each does

#Your settings

FileWhat it holds
dconf (org.aurora.desktop)Almost every Aurora setting. See GSettings keys.
~/.config/labwc/rc.xmlKeyboard shortcuts, input devices, workspaces, window behavior (both sessions read it). Safe to edit; Settings keeps your changes.
~/.config/aurora/wayfire.iniThe Aurora session's compositor configuration, generated from your settings: don't edit, it's rewritten.
~/.config/aurora/compositorwayfire or labwc: the compositor of the Aurora session.
~/.config/aurora/locale.confYour language and formats.
~/.config/aurora/keyboard.confYour keyboard layouts.
~/.config/aurora/displays.shThe display layout, applied at login.
~/.config/aurora/desktop-profiles.jsonYour saved desktop profiles.
~/.config/aurora/welcome-donePresent once the Welcome app has run.
~/.config/autostart/Apps that start at login (and overrides that turn system ones off).
~/.config/gtk-4.0/gtk.css, ~/.config/gtk-3.0/gtk.cssAurora's style imports; add your own CSS below Aurora's header line.
~/.config/starship.tomlThe prompt (start from /etc/aurora/starship.toml).
~/.bashrcAnything on top of /etc/aurora/bashrc.

#Your data

FolderWhat it holds
~/.local/share/aurora/widgets/Notes and to-do lists of the desktop widgets
~/.local/share/aurora/screentime/Screen time, one file per day
~/.local/share/aurora/daily/Pictures of the day (the last week)
~/.local/share/aurora/solid/Solid-color backgrounds
~/.local/share/backgrounds/Pictures you added as backgrounds
~/.cache/aurora/Weather, the current wallpaper link, thumbnails (safe to delete)
~/.local/state/aurora/Session state and the compositor fallback log
~/Pictures/Screenshots, ~/Videos/ScreencastsScreenshots and screen recordings

#System

File or folderWhat it is
/usr/lib/aurora/aurora/Aurora's desktop (Python)
/usr/share/aurora/Default configuration, styles, the startup script
/usr/share/wayland-sessions/aurora*.desktopThe two sessions
/etc/greetd/config.tomlThe login manager
/etc/default/locale, /etc/default/keyboardThe system's language and keyboard
/etc/aurora/Aurora's shell defaults (bashrc, starship) and the live session's configuration
/usr/share/backgrounds/aurora/The included wallpapers, including the dynamic set
